newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil July industrial output up 4.3 pct -IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil July industrial output up 4.3 pct -IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian industrial output in July rose 4.3 percent from June and 9.6 percent in comparison with July last year, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
However, the cumulative indices for the last 12 months and the first seven months of this year remained negative, falling 4.1 percent and 2.6 percent, respectively, the IBGE said in a statement.
"The figures point towards a strong recovery in industrial production in July," the IBGE said. The month-on-month figure was the highest since June last year.

Output increased in 16 of the 20 industrial sectors covered in the IBGE survey. Rubber, beverages, transport materials, pharmaceuticals, tobacco and electrical and communication materials expanded more than 4.3 percent, the IBGE said.
Production of durable consumer goods continued to lead the increase in industrial output, rising 10 percent in July from June.
Production of non-durable and semi-durable goods grew only 1.4 percent in July.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
